JOURNAL_TRANSLATOR.Title: Journal Translator

Mode.InPlaceHint: The journals themselves are translated. The original is saved and can be restored at any time. Map pins and all references keep working.
Mode.CopyHint: The journals are copied into a new folder and translated there. Links between the copies are redirected, but map pins still point to the originals.

JOURNAL_TRANSLATOR.Force: Re-translate pages that are already translated
JOURNAL_TRANSLATOR.ForceHint: Finished pages are normally skipped, so an interrupted run can simply be resumed.
JOURNAL_TRANSLATOR.GlossaryHint: One term per line: source = translation. Sent with every request to keep terminology consistent.
JOURNAL_TRANSLATOR.RestoreConfirm: Restore the original text of {count} journal(s)? The translation is kept and can be brought back at any time with "Restore translation".

Notify.NoKey: No API key configured for the selected provider. Please set one in the module settings.
Notify.NoSelection: Please select at least one journal.
Notify.NoBackup: None of the selected journals has a saved original.
Notify.Done: Translation finished: {done} segments, {failed} kept in the original language ({minutes} min).
Notify.Cancelled: Translation cancelled. Finished pages are saved; starting again resumes.
Notify.GMOnly: Only the GM can translate journals.
Notify.NoTranslation: None of the selected journals has a saved translation.

ApiKey.Name: API key: {provider}
ApiKey.Hint: Stored only in this browser (client setting) and sent directly to the provider.

Model.Name: Model: {provider}
Model.Hint: Model ID as documented by the provider.

Effort.Name: Claude: effort
Effort.Hint: How much Claude thinks. "low" is usually enough for translation and is cheaper and faster.

TargetLanguage.Name: Target language
TargetLanguage.Hint: Language to translate into (best given in English, e.g. German).

MaxChars.Name: Characters per request
MaxChars.Hint: Larger requests are cheaper (less repeated prompt), smaller ones more robust.

Concurrency.Name: Parallel requests
Concurrency.Hint: Lower this if you hit rate limits.

PriceInput.Name: Input price (USD per 1M tokens)
PriceInput.Hint: 0 = use the built-in price list for known models. Only used for cost estimates.

KeepLabels.Name: Do not translate link labels for
KeepLabels.Hint: Document types whose names stay original in links (comma separated). Scene = maps, Actor = characters and monsters. Others: Item, JournalEntry, JournalEntryPage, RollTable.

JOURNAL_TRANSLATOR.Counting: Counting tokens with the provider's tokenizer…

Count.Exact: Counted exactly with the provider's (free) token counting for {model}.
Count.Tokenizer: Counted with the OpenAI tokenizer (o200k) for {model}. A good approximation for other providers.
Count.Input: {segments} text segments in {requests} requests: {input} input tokens (including {system} tokens of instructions + glossary per request).
Count.Output: Estimated output: {low} – {high} tokens (German is a bit longer than English).
Count.PriceList: Prices from the built-in list: ${input} / ${output} per 1M tokens (input/output). Please verify with the provider; can be overridden in the settings.
Count.PriceSettings: Prices from the settings: ${input} / ${output} per 1M tokens (input/output).
Count.NoPrice: No price known for this model. Enter it in the settings to see costs.
Count.Thinking: Models with thinking (Claude, GPT-5, Gemini Pro) produce extra thinking tokens billed as output. Tip: translate one chapter first to see the real cost.

JOURNAL_TRANSLATOR.HasTranslation: Translation saved, can be restored at no cost
JOURNAL_TRANSLATOR.FailedReasons: Why segments were kept in the original (details in the console, F12)
JOURNAL_TRANSLATOR.RepairDone: Restored the original map, character and monster names in links on {count} page(s).

Links.Ok: All links in the selected journals work.
